decision_policy.ridge_and_gb: Convert each probability to its empirical OOF percentile. Broad direction is the sign of their summed centered percentiles; broad confidence is the weaker absolute centered percentile.
decision_policy.anchor: Average four oriented empirical percentiles: dist_to_high20_pct positive; ema21_50_pct, rsi14, and cum_vol_delta_to_avg inverse.
decision_policy.mixture: Convert broad and anchor scores to OOF percentiles. Use the component farther from 0.5.
decision_policy.publish: RED if final_score <= 0.189843750000; GREEN if final_score >= 0.847656250000; otherwise ABSTAIN.

selection_evidence.important_warning: Architecture and hyperparameters were selected after reviewing the second 750. These are retrospective research results, not untouched forward proof.

production_feature_engineering.prediction_input: Use the immediately completed confirmed candle before the target boundary. Never use target-candle values.
production_feature_engineering.minimum_history: At least 5 consecutive completed 15-minute technical rows are needed for d4 features; the underlying technical pipeline may require more history.
production_feature_engineering.continuity: Current input, previous-1, and previous-4 rows must belong to the exact uninterrupted 15-minute sequence. Missing history is OP_FAIL.

derived_feature_formulas.d1_*: current completed-candle base feature minus the immediately previous completed-candle base feature
derived_feature_formulas.d4_*: current completed-candle base feature minus the base feature four completed candles earlier

production_feature_engineering.imputation: Apply the frozen median imputer arrays in model feature order only after the source row and history pass validity gates. Log every imputed feature.

inference_math.empirical_percentile: searchsorted(sorted_values, value, side='right') / N; equivalently count(values <= value) / N
inference_math.gradient_boosting: raw=ln(class_prior_green/class_prior_red); for each stump add learning_rate*(left_value if feature<=threshold else right_value); p_green=sigmoid(raw)
inference_math.broad_score: r=ridge_percentile-0.5; g=gb_percentile-0.5; if r+g==0 score=0.5 else score=0.5+sign(r+g)*min(abs(r),abs(g))
inference_math.anchor_score: Average four oriented empirical percentiles. Positive orientation uses percentile; inverse orientation uses 1-percentile.
inference_math.component_selection: Convert broad_score and anchor_score to their frozen OOF percentiles. Use the one farther from 0.5. On exact distance tie, use broad_percentile.

armor.history_basis: Maintain base V6 predictions, before Armor. The saturation window contains current base prediction plus the seven preceding eligible base predictions. Clear the window after a continuity failure.
rule_order: Evaluate pickups only when the original base V6 prediction was ABSTAIN.
Apply weak-broad RED veto only to a RED whose source remains V6_BASE.

scoring.notes: PUSH is excluded, not scored as zero. Operational failures are reported separately and excluded from model performance.
